basic_info.description: Nestled between esteemed Nob Hill and Chinatown, 43-47 John Street offers an excellent investment opportunity for owner/occupiers and investors alike. This 3-unit building features a VACANT top unit in fixer condition, a blank slate for visionaries to customize to their liking! Each unit is charming a full-floor flat featuring 2BD/1BA, a spacious living room in the front, and a bright dining room and kitchen in the back. Also available is a vacant garage with one-car parking space, large storage room, and ample space for additional use. The building is separately metered for gas and electricity. The property is situated in a historic San Francisco neighborhood boasting convenience, cultural richness, and access to iconic landmarks. The investment appeal of this property is not only its exceptional location but the renovation potential for an owner-occupier or those looking for value-add potential to maximize rents.
